newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 202.90/203.30 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 202.90/203.30 to dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 202.90-203.30 per dollar at the close of the interbank market from 202.30/60 in the morning and 201.80/202 at Tuesday's close due to scarce foreign currency supply, dealers said.

"(Foreign exchange) supply was once again insufficient to meet demand and the lev was pressured beyond 203 per dollar at the close," one dealer said. Both final clients and commercial banks were bidding for dollars, dealers said.
The central bank sold foreign currency directly to large final clients in a bid to relieve pressure on the lev, another dealer said.
According to dealers today's trade was relatively thin with the larger part of the volume exchanged between 202.60 and 202.80 levs per dollar. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
